friendly_fire.description: Players cannot damage or kill members of their own faction. Squads inherit the same protection.

squad_rules.description: Squads are smaller opt-in groups inside an existing faction team. They create social closeness without changing the faction alliance.

radio_rules.description: Radios bind squadmates together for voice/comms-style gameplay. They do not create cross-faction channels.

description: V0.1 multiplayer intent: faction members are already allies, players may form same-faction squads, and team killing is disabled.
